messages.en:
{07 04 00}Oh, yeah{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}. The {ff 00 00 03}Flea Market
{ff 00 00 00}is today, right?

{07 06 00}I have to go! I've got this
nasty old couch I want to
sell, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Ah jaa{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}. {ff 00 00 03}Kirbuturg
{ff 00 00 00}on täna, eks?

{07 06 00}Ma pean minema! Mul on üks
jälk vana diivan, mida tahan
müüa, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}So today is that {ff 00 00 03}Flea
Market{ff 00 00 00} everyone has been
talking about!
{07 00 00}I should go check out
everyone's stuff,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0d 00}Wouldn't it be SWEET if
someone was selling an
edible marshmallow chair?!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Nii et täna on see {ff 00 00 03}kirbu-
turg{ff 00 00 00}, millest kõik on
rääkinud!
{07 00 00}Ma peaksin minema kõigi
kraami vaatama,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0d 00}Kas poleks MAGUS, kui keegi
müüks söödavat
vahukommitooli?!

messages.en:
{07 15 00}I can't wait to stock up on
used furniture at the
{ff 00 00 03}Flea Market{ff 00 00 00}!{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 0e 00}Furniture is cooler when
it looks a little loved,
don't you think?
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Ma ei jõua ära oodata, et
{ff 00 00 03}kirbuturult{ff 00 00 00} kasutatud
mööblit varuda!{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 0e 00}Mööbel on lahedam, kui see
näeb natuke armastatud
välja, kas pole?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hey {04 1f 00}, {07 0b 00}do you
have any furniture that you
want to sell, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 14 00}Then you better hurry back
to your place and see if
someone shows up to buy it!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Hei {04 1f 00}, {07 0b 00}kas sul on
mööblit, mida tahaksid
müüa, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 14 00}Siis kiirusta parem koju ja
vaata, kas keegi tuleb
seda ostma!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}You've got loads of cute
stuff I want to buy!

{07 16 00}But the thing is, {01 00 00 05 00}{01 00 00 05 00}I can't
buy any of it unless you go
back home!
{07 01 00}And you DO NOT want to get
between me and a sweet
deal, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Sul on hunnik nunnut
kraami, mida tahan osta!

{07 16 00}Aga asi on selles, {01 00 00 05 00}{01 00 00 05 00}et ma ei
saa midagi osta, kui sa
koju ei lähe!
{07 01 00}Ja sa EI TAHA jääda minu
ja hea tehingu
vahele, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 04 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 0b 00}What are you
doing here, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?!

{07 16 00}I've already rummaged
through everyone else's
furniture!
{07 1c 00}You're the last hope! If you
don't have cool stuff to
buy, {07 10 00}I'll be shattered!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 0b 00}Mida sa
siin teed, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?!

{07 16 00}Ma olen juba kõigi teiste
mööbli läbi
tuhninud!
{07 1c 00}Sa oled viimane lootus! Kui
sul pole lahedat kraami
müüa, {07 10 00}olen ma purustatud!
